finding: Auth carrier on the wire: genai used x-goog-api-key-header, the AI SDK used x-goog-api-key-header (same form). Custom header reached the wire: genai=true, ai-sdk=true; llxprt User-Agent survived: genai=true, ai-sdk=true. A deliberately invalid key was rejected by genai=true and ai-sdk=true. The header stamping and custom-header merge in GeminiProvider.createHttpOptions carries over unchanged.
